title: Common providers: Japan
coverage: Complete for the national carriers, the four mobile network operators, the main cable operator and the regional power-company fibre carriers; business ISPs are partial.
missing: Smaller business ISPs and the retail ISP brands that resell NTT fibre access
An AS number for NTT West (none confirmed)
An announced AS number for NTT East (AS17933 is registered to it and was not announced on the read date)
HTNet, the Hokuriku regional carrier (no AS number confirmed)

sources.name: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC): telecommunications carriers data
sources.terms: The ministry site states the Public Data License 1.0 (reuse with the source named). The page gives counts of carriers, not a register of names: nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. A public register of carrier names was not found in the time given; the ministry is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Japan
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 5 of 22 entries were found on the page under their name or one of their other names.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 22 of 22 websites answered an automated check; an address that did not answer, or that refused an automated request, is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 23 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: APNIC RDAP (the registry's own record of an AS number)
sources.terms: The APNIC Whois terms allow lookups for internet operational purposes and forbid bulk copying or redistribution without consent: nothing is copied.
sources.result: Read where the holder name in RIPEstat did not name the provider plainly.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.
